name: kvasir-agent
description: Kvasir-agent Codex plugin with MCP-only default research semantics for project-local research state. Codex-native tools handle routine file, shell, Git, test, build, and process work.

interface.shortDescription: MCP-only default for Kvasir-agent research state.
interface.longDescription: A self-contained Codex CLI plugin exposing project-local research state through scripts/ka_mcp.py as the MCP-only default research control plane. Ordinary file editing/search, shell, Git, tests, builds, and process management remain Codex-native responsibilities. `/goal` is Codex-native; Kvasir-agent does not implement slash commands.
defaultPrompt: MCP-only default: use scripts/ka_mcp.py and curated ka_* tools for project-local research state.
`/goal` is Codex-native; Kvasir-agent does not implement slash commands.
Use Codex-native file/shell/Git/test/build for routine work; ka_bash_exec is formal provenance only.
